critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1010 lines after iter-2 additions. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (leads.py, documents.py, employees.py, calls.py, etc.) before next iteration — the file is past the 700-line guideline.
GET /api/leads/{lead_id}/documents enriches each doc with uploader_name via N+1 queries to db.users. For a lead with many docs this is O(N). Consider a single $lookup aggregation or batched fetch.
GET /api/employees/{emp_id}/stats also issues an N+1 lookup for lead_name/company per recent_activity entry. Same recommendation: batch or $lookup.

/api/documents/{doc_id}/download accepts ?auth=<jwt> in the query string. Tokens in URLs can leak via referrer headers / browser history / proxy logs. Consider short-lived signed URLs from object storage, or POST-based download instead.

MAX_DOC_BYTES = 15MB is enforced after the entire file is read into memory (await file.read()). For very large rejects, this still loads up to the full body. Consider streaming + Content-Length check.

CSV importer always sets assigned_to=user['id'] and ignores any 'assigned_to' column in the CSV (the column is not even in CSV_FIELDS but should be documented). Either drop the constant CSV_FIELDS list (it is declared but never used) or honor 'assigned_to' from the CSV.

rca of the issue: Documents tab unreachable: developer added <TabsContent value='documents'> at LeadDetail.jsx:272 and imported LeadDocuments at line 20, but forgot to add a corresponding <TabsTrigger value='documents'> inside <TabsList> (lines 130-136).
